subject: o or 1 under conditions in the truthtable, please

messages.author: bce774183c9421c1
messages.subject: o or 1 under conditions in the truthtable, please
parts:
Hi everyone, 

Could I please ask a probably-obvious-and-a-bit-silly question related to the truthtable produced in R? 

When we use fuzzy set QCA, and the truthtable is produced in R. What does 0 and 1 under each condition mean? 

Is this correct to say 1 under condition A indicates the condition A is present in that country (for example in country A and B - the first row in the attached image)? 
O under Condition B indicates the condition B is absent in Country A and B? 


Thank you
Kind regards
Sarah

messages.author: 53dbab5845ace6b6
messages.subject: Re: o or 1 under conditions in the truthtable, please
parts:
Dear Sarah,

When the truth table is produced, cases are assigned to its unique configurations based on how close they are to that particular corner of a multi-dimensional vector space.
You might want to take a look at the Chapter 7 from this resource:
https://bookdown.org/dusadrian/QCAbook/truthTable.html
(particularly at section 7.3 about hot to get "From fuzzy sets to crisp truth tables")

Best wishes,
Adrian
